Descriptions: During the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, and if Astra Yao expends Energy to release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> to attack, both Astra Yao and the incoming character's ATK are increased. The increase is equal to <color=#2BAD00>22%</color> of Astra Yao's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 1,200. The effect lasts for 20s and can be extended up to 30s with repeated triggers.

Cons.Name: 12-Tone Equal Temperament
Cons.Effect: When Astra Yao's attack hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 6%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon entering the battlefield, Astra Yao immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. When activating her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, all squad members gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Song of Protection</color> for 60s. When attacked by an enemy, consume <color=#FFFFFF>Song of Protection</color>, granting Invulnerability for 1s.

Cons.Name: Art of Greed
Cons.Effect: The ATK buff from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: "Graceful Andante"</color> is further increased by 19%, with an increased maximum of 400. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, Astra Yao will additionally follow up with 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> and 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color> to attack. This effect can trigger once every 3s.

Cons.Name: "Hair Upon Your Nape"
Cons.Effect: After activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, within 15s, Astra Yao can trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> even if she does not have <color=#FFFFFF>Chords</color>. When the attack hits an enemy, the interval for triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is reduced to 1s. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when other squad members enter the field via a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, they will receive different buffs based on their specialty, and this effect can be triggered once every 3s for the entire squad: <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color>: The next <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> heavy attack on an enemy will deal extra DMG equal to 300% of Astra Yao's ATK; <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color>: The next <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will have 50% increased Anomaly Buildup; <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color>: The next <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will inflict 50% increased Daze.

Cons.Name: We Are the World
Cons.Effect: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, the DMG multiplier for <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color> released or followed up with will increase to 200% of the original, and CRIT Rate is increased by 80%. When triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Precise Assist</color>, Astra Yao will automatically follow up with the charged 3rd-hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: "Capriccio"</color>, with a 80% increased CRIT Rate. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
